decision_rule: These are evidence combinations for a research review, not automatic trading thresholds. A monthly decline can coexist with a higher quarterly average. Reassess breadth, magnitude and direction separately.
history_note: Complete-quarter, lag-0 SK hynix ASP tests on the 28 October data vintage. Chronological estimation; historical release timestamps are not fully reconstructed. These are contemporaneous classifications, not advance-warning probabilities.
history_conclusion: BOK is more informative than raw customs unit values in this sample. Its regression beats prior-quarter ASP persistence but not direct BOK growth. Recent-period errors are larger, especially for NAND; the extra history does not justify a precise Q4 ASP forecast.
